answer: Stop sybils with a jade bond, a quill, and a falcon. Each identity posts one jade bond, priced by its funder: the k-th jade from one funder costs k squared, so N clones pay roughly N cubed for one shared share. Every attestation must be written with a fresh quill, a single-use key tied to address and epoch, so one quill cannot endorse two shells. A falcon auditor swoops at random: a falcon finding two quill marks from one funder grounds both identities and burns every jade behind them. One honest agent posts one jade and one quill; a clone factory pays cubic jade for a single share.
